// spec: 01-02 ブロックと文
// 06-03「字下げ」
import Benitoite.IO.Console

function classify(n: Integer) -> String
  if n < 0 then
    return "negative"
  else if n = 0 then
    return "zero"
  else
    bind label <- match n with
      case 1 -> "one"
      case _ ->
        "many"
    end match
    return label
  end if
end function

function main() -> Unit uses Console.Write
  List.forEach([1, 2], lambda(item)
    Console.writeLine(classify(item))
  end lambda)
  bind total <- 1
    + 2
    + 3
  Console.writeLine(
    "${total}"
  )
end function

import Benitoite.IO.Console

record Person
  name: String
  age: Integer
end record

function getOr[A](opt: Option[A], default: A) -> A

    case Option.Some(x) -> x
    case Option.None -> default
  end match
end function

  bind q <- Person(..p, age: 2)
  bind xs <- [1, 2, 3]
  bind n: Integer <- -(1 + 1)
  bind inc <- lambda(x: Integer) return x + 1 end lambda
  bind ys <- xs |> List.map(inc)
  bind ok <- not (n > 0 and n < 10)
  Console.writeLine("n=${n} ok=${ok} ys=${ys}")
end function

// 06-03「整形の例」
import Benitoite.IO.Console

data Shape
  Circle(Float)
  Rect(Float, Float)
end data

function area(s: Shape) -> Float
  return match s with
    case Shape.Circle(r) -> 3.14159 * r * r // circle
    case Shape.Rect(w, h) ->
      w * h
  end match
end function

function main() -> Unit uses Console.Write
  bind shapes <- [Shape.Circle(1.0), Shape.Rect(2.0, 3.0)]
  // total area
  bind total <- shapes
    |> List.map(area)
    |> List.fold(0.0, lambda(acc, a) return acc + a end lambda)
  Console.writeLine("total: ${total}")
end function

//! JSON の三つの公開関数を CLI のケースで比較する共通の補助。
import Benitoite.Unofficial.Json
import Benitoite.Unofficial.IO.Console

function description(result: Result[Json.Value, Json.ParseError]) -> String
  return match result with
    case Result.Ok(value) -> "ok " + Json.stringify(value)
    case Result.Error(error) -> "error ${Json.ParseError.line(error)}:${Json.ParseError.column(error)} " + Json.ParseError.message(error)
  end match
end function

/// 独立した A と値・二つの出力を比較する。
public function compare(source: String, parse: function(String) -> Result[Json.Value, Json.ParseError], stringify: function(Json.Value) -> String, writePretty: function(Json.Value) -> String) -> Result[Unit, String] uses Console.Write
  bind a <- Json.parse(source)
  bind b <- parse(source)
  bind equal <- a = b
  bind output <- match Pair(a, b) with
    case Pair(Result.Ok(x), Result.Ok(y)) -> Json.stringify(x) = stringify(y) and Json.stringifyPretty(x) = writePretty(y)
    case Pair(Result.Error(_), Result.Error(_)) -> true
    case _ -> false
  end match
  Console.writeLine(description(a) + " | value=${equal} output=${output}")
  return if equal and output then Result.Ok(()) else Result.Error("compact=" + (match b with
    case Result.Ok(v) -> stringify(v)
    case _ -> "error"
  end match) + " A=" + description(a) + " B=" + description(b)) end if
end function

// 深さの境界は解析の値と診断だけで確かめ、出力の契約は別の表に任せる。
/// 解析の境界を値と誤りで比較する。
public function compareDepth(source: String, parse: function(String) -> Result[Json.Value, Json.ParseError]) -> Result[Unit, String] uses Console.Write
  bind a <- Json.parse(source)
  bind b <- parse(source)
  bind equal <- a = b
  Console.writeLine(description(a) + " | value=${equal}")
  return if equal then Result.Ok(()) else Result.Error("A=" + description(a) + " B=" + description(b)) end if
end function

/// 解析で作れない値の二つの出力を比較する。
public function writeValue(label: String, value: Json.Value, stringify: function(Json.Value) -> String, writePretty: function(Json.Value) -> String) -> Result[Unit, String] uses Console.Write
  bind compact <- Json.stringify(value) = stringify(value)
  bind pretty <- Json.stringifyPretty(value) = writePretty(value)
  Console.writeLine("${label} | compact=${compact} pretty=${pretty} bytes=${String.byteLength(Json.stringify(value))}")
  return if compact and pretty then Result.Ok(()) else Result.Error(label) end if
end function

/// 出力する深い値を末尾呼び出しで組み立てる。
public function deep(n: Integer, value: Json.Value) -> Json.Value
  return if n = 0 then value else deep(n: n - 1, value: Json.Value.Array([value])) end if
end function
